summary: Customer C13171 reported an unauthorized online purchase of $55.68 (transaction T3558054) made on 2016-12-19 using card C13171-K2. The transaction occurred on a new device ('f7b3887f9e33') that was not previously seen on this account. The customer has a long transaction history with numerous prior closed fraud cases, indicating repeated targeting or compromise of their accounts. Based on the customer report and the use of an unrecognized device for a card-not-present transaction, the verdict is fraud.
analyst_notes: Transaction T3558054 was executed via online channel using a newly found device key f7b3887f9e33.; Customer C13171 has 19 prior closed fraud cases, demonstrating a history of recurring account compromise.
